events.title: SPRINGTIME IN TOKYKO – Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons
events.description: Experience a classical music performance of Vivaldi's iconic 'The Four Seasons' by candlelight, presented by ArtsNational Sunshine Coast in an intimate gallery setting. Includes a glass of wine.

events.title: LORE and LAND (Exhibition Opening Event)
events.description: Attend the opening night of the 'LORE and LAND' exhibition, celebrating Indigenous art and storytelling. This is a chance to meet artists and engage with the themes, with the first drink included.

events.title: LORE and LAND (Exhibition)
events.description: Explore 'LORE and LAND', an exhibition showcasing Indigenous art and narratives. This free exhibition offers insights into First Nations culture and connection to country.

events.title: Chocolate Starfish | ALL FIRED UP Classic Hits '26 Tour
events.description: Catch Australian rock band Chocolate Starfish on their 'All Fired Up' tour, performing classic hits and fan favourites live at The Events Centre.

events.title: Running in the Shadows of Fleetwood Mac
events.description: Enjoy a tribute performance to the legendary Fleetwood Mac, featuring their classic songs and iconic sound. A night for fans of rock and pop music.

events.title: Yoga in the garden
events.location: Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: Start your Saturday with an outdoor yoga class amidst the serene Sculpture Garden. A grounded and community-focused session suitable for all levels, pay cash on the day.

events.title: Welcome to Your Botanic Garden (Guided Walk)
events.location: Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: Join a guided walk to explore the Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden and learn about its diverse plant life and ecosystems. A gentle, informative introduction to the garden.

events.title: Meet the Rainforest Guided Walk
events.description: Discover the unique flora and fauna of the subtropical rainforest at Mary Cairncross Scenic Reserve on this free guided educational walk. Learn about conservation and local ecology.

events.title: Reconnecting with Nature
events.location: Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: Engage in a mindful morning session designed to foster a deeper connection with nature in the tranquil Sculpture Garden. Focus on presence and sensory awareness in a group setting.

events.title: Imaginate: Fields of Feelings with Bonnie Hislop (Exhibition)
events.description: Visit the 'Imaginate: Fields of Feelings' exhibition by Bonnie Hislop, featuring vibrant and engaging artworks. A free contemporary art display at the Noosa Regional Gallery.
